description:
[Trading Data API] ICT liquidity levels: buy-side liquidity (above swing highs) & sell-side (below swing lows), sweep/taken status, relative-equal pools, and nearest untaken targets — ICT liquidity levels: buy-side liquidity (above swing highs) & sell-side (below swing lows), sweep/taken status, relative-equal pools, and nearest untaken targets. Crypto or stocks.

**Example:** `/v1/liquidity-levels?symbol=TQQQ&timeframe=1h`

equal_threshold_pct.description: Optional. Group swings within this % as relative-equal pools (default 0.1).

include_swept.description: Optional. true to include already-taken levels (default false = resting only).

swing_length.description: Optional. Pivot strength — bars each side of a swing (default 5). Tune to match your chart indicator.

symbol.description: Required. e.g. BTC, NVDA, TQQQ (or any with &class=).

name: liquidity_levels
